notes.title: Plans
notes.notes:
[p]Okay, so I have now struck off most htings on my todo list.  [/p][p]I've been thinking that I will aim to do 1 news post like this per week rather than random updates whenever I feel like it. It becomes a lot to manage and frequent almost daily updates to the game can feel quite chaotic as a player.  [/p][p]Moving forward I would like to move towards a more strucutred approach. [/p][list][*][p] Weekly news posts.[/p][/*][*][p] Weekly bug fix patches.[/p][/*][*][p] Monthly content drops. (This could be a little flexible +- a week or so)[/p][/*][/list][p]
I've spent some time talking on discord a bunch with people about where I see Carl's trails going

My thoughts are still really chaotic around this system and I need a fair bit more time to think on it. The most recent thinking is to manage a group of echoes as your autobattler army procedurally generated skill trees for the roguelite runs and then skill points earned as carl levels up that can be used for meta progression.

Another thing we've discussed which everyone seems pretty keen on is [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45695294/b294f6e0eab47f4210f7102b66e5ede8f6f5a124.png"][/img]
Additionally you might earn some legendary cards at a low chance with different cards being found in different maps these would be unique effects perhaps things like speeding up the forge or cauldron.

In other news I have a really solid idea thanks to jesperds here in the steam community which would involve Barkley and Wren along with a new fletching mechanic. I am curious how many of you would like to see that implemented before the Reaper Trials?

My other main task that I have at the moment is preparing all the achievements for Google and Apple platforms.

I am considering ditching steam leaderboards for a cross platform alternative like Playfab or Unity Gaming Services, which would also open up an avenue for account based cloud saving where you could swap between mobile and pc at will.

Anyway I will catch you all next week and in the comments. its time for dinner![/p]

notes.title: A micro roadmap.
notes.notes:
[p]Hey guys, I just got back from my holiday.

So as promised I'm writing up my plans and this post is here to keep you informed.

Over the next week I will be working on improving a bunch of the existing systems. My todo list is a bit of a mess but some notible things include.[/p][olist][*][p]Adding Cow, Sheep, and pig to the game.[/p][/*][*][p]A new tooltip for the cauldron showing what cards do.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing a bug where the category boarders don't show up consistently.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved echo targeting when you have multiple combat echoes.[/p][/*][*][p]Making Alter Echoes, Skills, and buffs accessible from a new dropdown whether you're in town or not.[/p][/*][/olist][p]While I do that I will be designing the next big mechanic for the game...

This is still relatively up in the air and I will make various posts about its progress over the next couple of weeks.

I think its high time EoV got some sort of skill tree. However I don't want to make some massively branching tree nor do I want it to just be some generic thing based on the existing gameplay.

I intend to give Carl a big part in this story and my current thoughts are some kind of trial where you will take on waves of enemies perhaps with mini procedural skill trees. Each wave you beat would give you a new skill point for your overall tree which might affect Carls trials in a permenant way as well as provide more stats and abilities for your existing runs.

As you can tell it hasn't got any real substance to it yet and it will likely change drastically as I iterate and try different things. 

I hope you're enjoying the game as much as I enjoy working on it! 
Many thanks for all the support you've shown over the last few days!

Regards Matt.[/p]

notes.title: An Apology
notes.notes: [p]I’ve heard a lot of feedback here on the steam community that the resets and issues with saves as well as the massive amount of content changes that have been happening are upsetting for a lot of you.[/p][p][/p][p]First of all I want to say my bad guys…[/p][p][/p][p]I’ve been really engrossed in expanding the game because I am actively playing it too. I got carried away and made too many changes too fast. I also lost track of time and thought that it had been longer than it had since I made the save announcement and kinda jumped the gun on releasing that patch.[/p][p][/p][p]If you still have your old save files you can jump on the unstable beta branch and import them there. If not or if you already restarted for the fresh experience please accept my apology with a promise to do better moving forwards. The save system is already orders of magnitude more stable than it was before and I will only keep improving on it. You can also use the import and export feature to back your saves up if you are concerned about it. [/p][p][/p][p]I will do better about communicating changes in advance moving forwards. [/p][p]I am on vacation for the next couple of days then I am going to spend some time iterating on the existing content polishing it off a bunch.[/p][p][/p][p]Over on discord we are working on plans for a fletching system that Barkley and Wren will be part of. And potentially a skill tree system managed by the reaper for late game. [/p][p][/p][p]I do understand why it has felt like early access to some of you and as such I do want to clarify that I expect to continue adding content for the foreseeable future. This is after all my dream game and I want it to be perfect. So once again I am sorry and I will learn from your feedback, thank you for taking the time to be part of this journey.[/p]

[p]• Chickens![/p][p]• I forgot to mention, cauldron is now locked behind some buff quests.[/p][p]• If you have save migration issues, switch to the unstable branch on steam to import your old save.[/p][p]• Extended the Cauldron window to be 6 slots wide.[/p][p]• Animations now speed up with task speed![/p][p]• Added the next 5 tiers of Resource Tiers.[/p][p]• Crafted items have no bonus, are set to max tier background and listed as "Crafted" in the items panel.[/p][p]• Fixed a bug where dice wasn't working properly.[/p]

[p]• 13 New Achievements.[/p][p]• 34 New Quests.[/p][p]• New Tiers for resources, low chance to tier up every time they're collected naturally.[/p][p]• Updated the Quest window to be more clear.[/p][p]• Echoes no longer expire while on task, instead they wait till their task is complete and then expire.[/p][p]• Echo bars now show as Green till 50% health, Yellow till 10%, and Red till they expire.[/p][p]• A Matter of Health, and Tracking Twins now award: 0.5% Increased Alter-Echo power. These are not retroactively granted, you will require a new save if you want these rewards and have completed the quest.[/p][p]• The Resource Doubler buff is now a Resource Multiplier buff so that it can scale with quests![/p][p]• Added indicators to the pie charts to show that you can hover over them or tap on mobile.[/p][p]• Major FPS performance improvements across the whole UI.[/p][p]• The farmlands no longer have enemies or increase your reap distance when being reaped.[/p][p]• Removed local avoidance from Caleb, echoes can now pass through him.[/p][p]• The Vast One has given Carl the secrets to defense, he can now bypass enemies defense to reap them correctly for you.[/p][p]• Vampirism has been changed. We no longer have lifesteal, instead its a percent regen buff. It has been renamed accordingly.[/p][p]• Buffs now have their cooldowns cleared when a run is longer than their cooldown.[/p][p]• The Cauldron now only accepts food items.[/p][p]• The Cauldron now shows all available slots instead of only 6.[/p][p]• 0 Count items are no longer selectable in the Cauldron.[/p][p]• Removed Onion.[/p][p]• Added collection completeion bonus to AE categories buffs the Echo Power in the AE screen.[/p][p]• Adjusted the overall curve of stat distribution on gear. It will now be much harder to roll perfect Vastium gear. And we should see less of a jump in stats on the earlier gear.[/p][p]• The forge now shows the tier of gear that you have equipped and roll.[/p][p]• You can now upgrade cores in the forge.[/p][p]• Forge Stats now shows a Quality section which works properly unlike the old score system which was comparing your best upgrade rather than the best it could be.[/p][p]• The bonus damage from the dice now just shows on the value itself, removed (+{bonusValue}) from the end.[/p][p]• Fixed an issue causing multiple save events to trigger in a single frame during AE collection.[/p][p]• New enemy balance standard damage scaling for Skelly Mage and Large Slimes 5 damage per level.[/p][p]• New enemy balance standard damage scaling for Skelly Archer and Medium Slimes 2.5 damage per level.[/p][p]• New enemy balance standard damage scaling for Skelly Swordsman and Small Slimes 1 damage per level.[/p][p]• Removed migration systems.[/p]

notes.title: Disabled Steam Cloud
notes.notes:
[p]Hey guys for now I have disabled steam cloud as I think it might be the cause of some of the wipes. Hopefully it will at least reduce in frequency till the new update with gear. 

Still hard at work on that! You can try it out in the unstable branch and if you have a wiped save backed up you can rename it to SdX.es3 where x is the number between 0-3 with 0 being slot 1, 1 being slot 2, and 2 being slot 3. Otherwise it should migrate your save automatically if you have an existing one.

Would love to have more feedback on the balance of gear which is way out of whack right now and would love additional help testing htings and ideas!

it's coming along really nicely and theres a few more things I need to do before it can be released! For example I need to rework the skills and stats screens to work with the new tab layout. And I need to create a system to sell resources for gold and upgrade your tools! 

I hope it wont be much more than another week but I cannot promise a date yet. Thanks for playing! Hope to see you on discord soon.[/p]
